messages:
maria: FYI escalation from Jordan — their app gets intermittent 5xxs and high tail latency. They pasted a small error blob below and asked what exact bits we need to debug.

customer-jordan: here is what I see in our logs: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2025 15:12:05 GMT
x-rw-request-id: rwd_8f7b2c
content-type: application/json

{
  "error": "Upstream timeout",
  "trace_id": "01-4b3a9c...-9f2d"
}
```

maria: perfect, thanks. Ben — can you paste a checklist we should ask them for (and a minimal curl repro) so we can run a support bundle?

ben: short checklist: 
- exact `x-rw-request-id` (root header) & any `trace_id` in the payload
- full raw HTTP request/response if possible (headers + body) or a curl that reproduces it
- SDK logs (DEBUG level) around the timestamp — include client time zone offset
- which region/endpoint, model name & pinned version, token counts
- whether they're using Redwood Hosted / Dedicated / Private and creds type (API key / OAuth)
- approximate local time and timezone of the failure (ISO8601)

Also ask them NOT to paste any end-user PII. Provide secure upload instructions if needed.

emily: add: if this looks billing-related (e.g., spike in tokens) include the invoice/billing_ref and last 4 of the org id so we can correlate.

ben: minimal curl to capture headers & response (they can run locally and paste):

```
export RW_KEY=REDACTED
curl -v \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","input":"hello"}' \
  --dump-header - \
  --max-time 30
```

Tell them to copy the entire stdout (headers + body). The `-v`/`--dump-header` lines make the `x-rw-request-id` visible.

maria: great. What about SDK users? Any helper methods to pull ids?

ben: yes, SDKs surface the request id in the response meta: e.g., Python: `resp.meta.request_id` or JS: `res.meta.requestId`. Also logs: set `REDWOOD_LOG=debug` and show the timestamped lines — the SDK prints `requestId=` in the request/response logs.

customer-jordan: we use the JS SDK — I can send `res.meta.requestId`. I grabbed `rwd_8f7b2c` and the trace `01-4b3a9c...-9f2d`. Anything else?

ben: ideal extras: the exact client SDK version (`npm ls @redwood/inference` or `pip show redwood-inference`), whether they set custom timeouts/retries, and a short note on traffic pattern (single user vs burst).

emily: once they provide the id we can run an internal query and, if needed, generate a debug bundle. For customers who can't share raw logs, we can create a support bundle and share a secure upload link.

maria: how do we generate the support bundle on our side?

support-bot: To collectors: run `support-bot collect-bundle --request-id rwd_8f7b2c --include-system-logs --include-runtime-metrics` — bundle id `sb_009832` created. Upload link expires in 72h. :lock: 

ben: note: our support tool will include tenant-scoped traces and server-side logs; it will NOT include customer payload bodies by default unless `--include-payloads` is passed (we should avoid unless customer explicitly consents).

maria: perfect. I'll reply to Jordan with a short template they can paste back.

maria (to customer-jordan): thanks — when you reply can you paste: 1) `x-rw-request-id` header value, 2) SDK response meta if available, 3) exact region & model, 4) a curl run output (stdout), and 5) local ISO timestamp of failure. We'll create a bundle and follow up within 2 business hours. :thumbsup:

customer-jordan: will do, sending now.

maria: quick privacy reminder to the team — redact any user content before posting externally; prefer secure upload for logs with PII.

ben: one more tip: if the customer reports latency, ask them to include client network egress metrics (connection type) and `ping`/`traceroute` to `api.redwood.inference` for region debugging.

emily: closing loop: once bundle is ready, tag `#eng-runtime` and `@oncall-runtime` with bundle id so the runtime team can pull KV cache traces.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll update thread once I have the bundle id from support-bot.
